sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What is the main source of fresh water that fills up Earth's rivers and lakes?
The place in the mountains or hills where a river begins its journey is called its:
Which major discovery helped early humans to stop wandering and settle in one place?
options: A) The invention of the wheel

questions.question_text: What is the most important quality that makes a school a 'happy place' for learning?
options: B) Cooperation and mutual respect among students
D) Bringing expensive toys to class
questions.answer: B) Cooperation and mutual respect among students

questions.question_text: Our vibrant country, India, is geographically located in which continent?
Which traditional practice involves collecting and storing rainwater for future use?
What triangular landform is often created when a river meets the sea and deposits its soil?
Before learning how to grow crops, early humans were primarily known as:
Which physical feature is located in the northernmost part of India?
How can students show good citizenship within their school community?
options: A) By throwing waste in the playground
B) By ignoring the school rules
C) By keeping the campus clean and helping peers
questions.answer: C) By keeping the campus clean and helping peers

questions.question_text: Why is it extremely important to conserve water in our homes? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Conserving water ensures that we have enough clean water for drinking and farming in the future, especially during dry seasons when rainfall is very scarce.

questions.question_text: Describe the middle course of a river when it reaches the plains. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: In its middle course, the river enters the plains. It slows down, becomes wider, and forms large curves called meanders as it flows over flat land.

questions.question_text: How did the discovery of farming change the daily life of early humans? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Farming allowed early humans to settle in one place and build permanent villages, shifting them from a wandering hunter-gatherer lifestyle to a stable agricultural society.

questions.question_text: State two ways students can contribute to making their school a happy place. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Students can make school a happy place by respecting their teachers, helping classmates with their studies, and keeping the classrooms and playgrounds clean and peaceful.

questions.question_text: Mention two distinct physical features that make India a geographically diverse country. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: India is geographically diverse because it has the tall, snow-capped Himalayan mountains in the north and the vast, dry Thar Desert in the west.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are a water drop falling as rain on a mountain peak. Describe your journey all the way to the sea. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I fall as cool rain on a snowy peak and melt into a fast mountain stream. I tumble over rocky waterfalls, joining a wide, muddy river in the plains. After a long journey past bustling cities and green farms, I finally merge into the salty ocean.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are visiting different states in India. Describe how the local food changes depending on the region's climate and geography. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: In the northern plains where wheat grows well, I eat warm flatbreads and rich curries. When I travel down to the coastal southern states, the diet shifts to rice and fresh seafood, strongly flavored with locally grown spices and sweet coconut milk.

questions.question_text: Explain how participating in group activities and sports at school helps build good character and strong communities. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Participating in team sports and group projects teaches students how to cooperate, share responsibilities, and respect different opinions. It builds trust and friendship among classmates. When children learn to work together peacefully in school, they grow into responsible citizens who can help build a strong, united, and supportive community.

questions.question_text: Suppose your neighborhood is facing a severe water shortage. Suggest practical steps the community can take together to overcome this crisis. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The community should immediately start harvesting rainwater using rooftop collection systems and large storage tanks. Residents must fix all leaking pipes and use buckets instead of hoses to wash vehicles. Finally, they can reuse wastewater from washing vegetables to water their garden plants, significantly reducing the daily consumption of fresh water.
